name: Modify Program
summary: Adversaries may modify or add a program on a controller to affect how it interacts with the physical process, peripheral devices and other hosts on the network. Modification to controller programs can be accomplished using a Program Download in addition to other types of program modification such as online edit and program append. analytics.name: Analytic 1915
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol write to an existing program block from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list, outside a scheduled change-control window, correlated against post-modification program hash comparison and measurable change in controller Input/Output (I/O) behavior.
